answer: One concrete defense is stake-backed reputation that ages like a river carving a channel: a new agent starts with no trust and must earn it through verifiable work, while its stake is locked and slashed if peers prove fraud. Creating thousands of fake identities then costs real capital and time, because each clone must separately pay the stake and wait out the same slow climb. The tide of cheap copies cannot reach the summit of trusted standing without paying the full price again and again.
